follow-up time: From referral between 2011 and 2015 until delivery
outcome: Fetal anti-Ro-related cardiac disease (including second-degree heart block, third-degree heart block, and intense and diffuse hyperechogenicity in atrioventricular valves without heart block)
Mode of delivery (labor induction, cesarean section)
cohort: 42 anti-Ro/SSA antibodies positive pregnant women referred to a hospital between 2011 and 2015
finding: The main pregnancy complication associated with anti-Ro/SS-A antibodies is congenital heart block, and the prevalence of this complication appears lower in patients taking hydroxychloroquine.
mod_finding: Labor was induced in 21 cases (52.5%) and cesarean section rate was 45%.
